principle: Scientific experiment gates and corpus-engineering gates are independent. A sealed prospective experiment must remain sealed while source, provenance, catalogue, rights, and representation work continues.

machine_resolvable.task: Materialize a canonical record-level corpus layer from the authenticated SigLA snapshot without redistributing prohibited raw payloads.
Populate inscription, occurrence, provenance and site tables from authenticated source-derived fields with source/license lineage.
Reconcile the 15 named unresolved cases against lawful primary images/plates or independent authoritative witnesses where accessible.
Complete source-level sign/transnumeration concordance and keep Linear B correspondences non-phonetic unless independently justified.
Refresh mutable repository metadata whose embedded content version predates the current repository state.

sealed_or_external.reason: Historical analytical input identity/independence unresolved; do not inspect outcomes.

sealed_or_external.task: Palaeographic adjudication, uncertain sign identity, disputed segmentation/metrology where sources do not resolve conflict

ceiling_rule: Do not declare PRE_EXPERT_MAXIMUM until every machine_resolvable item is COMPLETE or SOURCE_BLOCKED with a concrete access/rights blocker.
